subject: Request: one-time service voucher and remediation plan after June 17 latency window
messages:
From: Elaine Turner <ops@broadline.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: support@broadline.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency incident (Jun 17) — request for remediation credit

Hi Vanessa,

We ran into a sustained latency spike on Jun 17 (roughly 13:05–15:10 UTC) that impacted our inference pipeline. Affected endpoints experienced 10–15s p95 response times and several 5xx errors during the window; this caused batch jobs to miss the processing cutoff and we fell back to a slower replica, increasing our infra spend.

Attached is a short summary from our ops team (broadline-impact-summary.pdf) and the uptime logs. We're not looking to escalate contract terms, but given the production impact we'd like to request a one-time remediation voucher (or equivalent bill credit) to offset the unexpected costs incurred that week.

Preliminary ask: $18,000 voucher applied to the next billing cycle, plus confirmation of the root cause and a mitigation timeline.

Can you confirm next steps and what evidence you need from us?

Thanks,
Elaine Turner
Head of Platform Ops
Broadline AI

My read: Broadline is a strategic mid-market account (BRD-5421), good CS relationship, and the timing is during their Q2 push. We should propose a quick goodwill package to avoid churn risk. Options:
